plan.summary: Put The Heart (the-heart-off-broadway-2026) back to previews. It shows 'Now Playing' / 'Opened Oct 29, 2026' while in previews (first preview 2026-10-08, opening 2026-10-29). update-show-status.js's review-driven catch-up (Check 2d, scoreThreshold) flipped it to open on the four Heart of Rock and Roll excerpts that BRO-4953 has since flagged wrongShow; they were dateless, so reviewsPredateRun could not see they predate the run. Check 2c would revert it at the next 08:00 UTC cron; this applies the same transition now.
steps: Set status open -> previews on the-heart-off-broadway-2026

actions.description: openingDate 2026-10-29 is in the future and previews began 2026-10-08: the state update-show-status.js Check 2c maps to 'previews'. The 'open' came from wrong-show reviews (BRO-4953).
